summary: PO/ARB's verbatim commissioned implementation prompt for AST-018: a DDD-oriented capability translating a human business decision ('Appoint a fresh independent reviewer') into governed REGISTER/HANDOFF/START mechanics without exposing mechanics, preserving Responsibility≠Authority, Eligibility≠Authorization, Recommendation≠Appointment, etc.

summary: Governance-recording of the PO/ARB's commission establishing KOS-NEXT-ACTOR-ORCHESTRATION-001 as a provisional work item, summarizing scope/boundaries, and explicitly barring the recorder from spawning a subagent as the 'fresh' implementation actor.

summary: A process refuses an instruction to REGISTER/HANDOFF/human-START a Governance reviewer lane for d31ea60f, because the PO/ARB appointment of d31ea60f is not confirmable from any authoritative record (only from prompt text), and this process is not itself a verified governance-recording actor.

summary: Governance-recording of the PO/ARB confirming the work-item name and appointing a fresh, unnamed implementation session for AST-018; the appointee is a placeholder pending identity self-declaration, and the mechanism reports UNRESOLVABLE (no record yet) rather than treating absence-of-record as freedom.

summary: Governance-recording of the PO/ARB's appointment of d31ea60f as Governance adoption reviewer, directing REGISTER(governance)→HANDOFF→human-START, and re-affirming that both prior gate refusals were correct behaviour whose missing object was precisely this recorded appointment.

summary: PO/ARB's preserved candidate-declaration prompt for the fresh AST-018 implementation session, instructing it to determine its own runtime identity, verify independence against six named barred identities, and stop before any REGISTER/HANDOFF/START.
contribution_assessment: Records the empirical finding that a subagent spawned from the recording session reports the parent's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (distinct OS PID only), proving a subagent cannot serve as the fresh actor.

summary: PO/ARB architectural decision extending the AST-018 commission with a third use case, PrepareNextActorSession: generate a complete, copy-pasteable 'Next Session Kickoff Prompt' from governed facts whenever a fresh OS session is required, so the human is never left to reconstruct the prompt manually.

summary: The AST-018 implementing actor records two out-of-scope findings discovered while implementing: FU-1, the authoritative workflow store (.claude/runtime/) is entirely gitignored and non-durable; FU-2, AST-017's identity-label extraction regex cannot distinguish a lane's registered actor from a mere prose mention of an unrelated actor's id, causing false AMBIGUOUS verdicts that grow monotonically with record size.
contribution_assessment: Documents a concrete false-ambiguity defect with live evidence (labels a8ce5a39/8b92a100 on lanes S5/S6) and a narrower artifact (labels captured with a trailing period), explicitly not corrected here to avoid invalidating the already-verified AST-017 correction.

summary: A fresh, identity-clean candidate verifier (7c2690ae) refuses to verify AST-018 because no verification lane exists, AND identifies a second, independent gate failure: the predecessor implementation lane was never explicitly STOPPED per its own declared sequence, so the record is not yet even at the point where a verifier is due.
contribution_assessment: Extends the gate-refusal doctrine with a compound-failure case (missing STOP + missing verification lane) and explicitly counts this as the seventh recorded refusal caused by a prompt asserting a lane the record does not carry.

summary: Governance-recording of the PO/ARB's Option-B decision creating KOS-OPERATING-MODEL-001, the FINAL GOVERNANCE + COMMUNICATION OPERATING MODEL work item, while explicitly preserving KOS-NEXT-ACTOR-ORCHESTRATION-001/AST-018 as a separate, unaffected, continuing slice.

summary: PO/ARB's verbatim 40-section implementation prompt for the FINAL OPERATING MODEL: a dedicated human-facing Governance Engineer responsibility plus a transferable Communication Engineer responsibility, five business session-outcomes, six human-facing interaction cases, fresh-session/wrong-session handling, review/adoption lifecycle, and the governing principle 'the human never operates the workflow engine.'
contribution_assessment: The single richest normative artifact in the batch: specifies 30 named TDD scenarios, the four-state separation (IMPLEMENTED≠VERIFIED≠ADOPTED≠AUTHORIZED), and an exhaustive list of things the human must never be required to know or do.

summary: Governance-recording of the PO/ARB confirming the work-item name and authorizing all three delivery layers (operating model, minimal supporting capability, verification/acceptance), appointing a fresh implementation session (placeholder identity).
contribution_assessment: Clarifies that 'minimal supporting capability' means the new software consumes existing AST-018 commands and must never become a second workflow engine or re-implementation of AST-015/017/018.

summary: Session Completion Report for the implementing session (259c1966): all three layers delivered (operating-model document, operating-model.php read-only presenter, 43-test contract suite GREEN), all four canonical assets byte-unchanged, status ACTIVE, next actor governance for STOP-then-verifier appointment.
contribution_assessment: Explicitly separates IMPLEMENTED/VERIFIED/ADOPTED/AUTHORIZED as four never-collapsed states per commission §38, with three of the four pending.

summary: Preserved candidate-declaration prompt for the fresh KOS-OPERATING-MODEL-001 verifier, listing nine barred identities (including the implementing session itself) and noting the work item is STOPPED (seq 4), so an explicit CONTINUATION must precede any REGISTER(verification).

summary: Governance-recording (by the implementing session itself, in disclosed capacity) of the PO/ARB's appointment of a fresh independent verifier; records the governed state as STOPPED, and that AST-018's next-actor/prepare-next-session both correctly refuse to act while STOPPED (NO_FRESH_ACTOR_REQUIRED).
contribution_assessment: Demonstrates AST-018 itself enforcing the sticky-STOPPED invariant live, refusing to prepare a kickoff prompt while the item is stopped.

summary: Records the PO/ARB's design refinement after watching a fresh verifier (fc59bb0a) correctly stop for lack of a lane: the old absolute rule 'a session must never register itself' is corrected as too strong; a new capability ActivateCommissionedFreshSession should let a fresh session self-register ONLY for its already-commissioned role, never choosing role/scope/work-item/authority itself, unifying first-session and subsequent-session onboarding under one binding model.

summary: Independent verifier fc59bb0a verifies all three KOS-OPERATING-MODEL-001 layers PASS (document, read-only presenter, 43/409 test suite; full regression 122/1307 green; cross-provider byte-identical), explicitly not claiming adoption or authorization.

summary: The correction author (b51dba91) also refuses the Governance adoption review of KOS-OPERATING-MODEL-001, disqualified both because it is the correction author of a related work item and because it holds no lane at all on this work item.

summary: Session Completion Report for the AST-019 (ActivateCommissionedFreshSession) implementation slice: GO-01..GO-25 GREEN (270 assertions), full regression 147/1577 green, IMPLEMENTED only — NOT VERIFIED/ADOPTED/AUTHORIZED.

summary: Governance-recording of the PO/ARB's appointment of a fresh Governance adoption reviewer for KOS-OPERATING-MODEL-001, noting the work item is STOPPED (seq 9) and that the newly-built AST-019 explicitly refuses to write the CONTINUATION needed to unstick it (GO-21).

summary: Evaluates an externally-proposed Sanskrit/Pāṇinian-grammar-inspired 'candidate set' architecture (Expression→Deterministic recognition→Candidate interpretations→Contextual/governance interpretation→Authorized decision→Deterministic execution), extracting the valuable structural insight while explicitly rejecting 'the Governance Interpreter determines the correct meaning' as dangerous, and proposing it only as candidate hypothesis AH-6.
contribution_assessment: Separates three distinct value sources (Sanskrit grammar as design-pattern source, compiler theory as implementation analogy, KnowledgeOS as consumer of structured candidates) and explicitly declines to reopen SNF research on the strength of the analogy alone, citing the HPA rule that development informs but never initiates research autonomously.

summary: Defines a candidate 'epistemic state-transition kernel' with eight capacities (K1 Identity, K2 Evidence, K3 Provenance/History, K4 Context, K5 Contradiction, K6 Temporal Evolution, K7 Constitutional Admissibility, K8 Deterministic State Transition), explicitly excluding semantic compiler/LLM/NL-parser/workflow-engine/database/UI from the Kernel, and proposing a Kernel-vs-Supporting-Systems capability-mapping exercise before any implementation.
contribution_assessment: States the invariant 'representation equality must never automatically become identity equality' (K1) and the 'capacity ceiling' principle that the Kernel must be structurally incapable of stating semantic meaning directly ('the sentence means X') rather than only reporting candidate/evidence/admissibility facts.

summary: Proposes a full 'constitutional knowledge engine' Kernel architecture: six pillars (Identity/Evidence/Context/Provenance/Contradiction/History), a six-stage kernel state machine (proposal receipt→constitutional pre-check→state retrieval→constitutional resolution→transition execution→post-transition verification), YAML data models for KnowledgeState/KnowledgeTransition, and a fail-closed failure-mode table.
contribution_assessment: Proposes rule-priority ordering (identity>evidence>context>contradiction>history) and a DDD/hexagonal folder layout (Domain/Application/Infrastructure with EventStore/StateStore/RulesEngine); this whole design is subsequently challenged and largely rejected by the DDD critique in S0360/S0361 as conflating too many responsibilities into one Kernel.

summary: Elaborates the S0358 proposal into a concrete Constitutional DSL grammar (CONSTITUTION/ENTITY/EVIDENCE/RULE/CONTRADICTION_RULE/TRANSITION_RULE), a closed intent-action/entity/relationship vocabulary with regex pattern-grammar parsing, and a full evidence model with numeric weighting (0.0-1.0 base weights per evidence type, multiplicative modifiers, 1.5x supersession threshold, 20% reconciliation band).
contribution_assessment: Provides the most concrete, code-adjacent artifact in the Kernel-brainstorming thread (full DSL grammar with a worked GovernanceConstitution v2.3.0 example); the numeric evidence-weighting scheme is explicitly flagged in the very next file (S0360) as a 'red flag' inconsistent with the platform's own OQ-5 ruling that confidence is domain-owned and structured, not a mechanism score.

summary: A DDD interrogation of the S0358/S0359 'constitutional knowledge engine' proposal: identifies that it conflates four distinct layers (KnowledgeOS domain, Application/Governance, Interpretation mechanisms, Kernel infrastructure) into one Kernel, introduces the Intent≠Command distinction, argues the aggregate (not the parser/interpreter/Kernel infrastructure) must own state transitions, and flags numeric evidence weighting as a 'mechanism-confidence laundered into truth/authority' red flag contradicting OQ-5.
contribution_assessment: Proposes the refined pipeline Human Expression→Interpretation→Intent Candidate→Governance Evaluation→Authorized Command→Domain Command Handling→Aggregate→Domain Event, and explicitly rejects the proposed implementation-first phase sequencing (DSL→Parser→Resolver→Trust→Execution) as inverting DDD by building the DSL before the domain concepts are defined.

summary: A multi-part document: (1) a full 'DDD Critical Review' rejecting the prior Constitutional Kernel proposal as a 'god object' conflating parsing/rule-evaluation/execution/history/contradiction-resolution/evidence-weighting/self-audit, with a falsification table (10 claims MOVE-OUT/SPLIT/KEEP) and a restricted Kernel definition (identity, state-transition admissibility, history, provenance, contradiction detection, evidence-reference preservation only); (2) a response challenging five of that review's own conclusions (Kernel-as-pure-function too strong; adjudication-vs-execution gap risk; governance-supplied-rules provenance problem; evidence narrower than 'references only'; invented bounded contexts not yet validated); (3) a follow-on noting F-1..F-5 work has now closed the domain-discovery gap with a 9-row MUST-EXIST capability map, concluding the Kernel is better framed as 'the authoritative admission boundary of KnowledgeCore' than as DeepSeek's 'pure function' formulation.
contribution_assessment: Contains the batch's most extensive single falsification exercise (10-row MOVE-OUT/SPLIT/KEEP table) plus a second layer of self-critique of that same review, and a third layer reconciling both against F-1..F-5 evidence; recommends a single, code-free, thirteen-part DDD consolidation question as the 'last DDD step before we can legitimately decide what the Kernel actually is.'

summary: Duplicate of the third (final) part of S0361: argues F-1..F-5 closed the domain-discovery gap with a 9-row MUST-EXIST capability map, resolves the 'Kernel as pure function' challenge by declaring the formulation too small, reframes the Kernel as 'the authoritative admission boundary of KnowledgeCore,' relocates the Sanskrit/FST research to sit before KnowledgeOS admission rather than inside the Kernel, and recommends a single consolidation question before any implementation decision.
contribution_assessment: This file's content is verbatim identical to the closing section of S0361 (the filename itself flags 'duplicate'); recorded per-file as required, but every distinct claim is already captured against S0361 and is not re-argued as new content here.
